kind_of_no: wma allowance, no designated campground found
why: 2026-11-12: no operator names a campground at Kulm-Edgeley Dam. The camping right there is ND Game and Fish's general WMA allowance on the 38-acre Kulm Dam WMA ('Most WMAs are ideal for ... primitive camping', 10-day limit; gf.nd.gov/wma and /wma-listing, August 2026), not a designated campground. Not on the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025). Not on Google Maps (a search for the campground lands on 13574 Edgeley Campground), The Dyrt, Campendium or RV Life. The G&F 2022 contour map and its facility layer show only a ramp, a dock and a vault toilet (Kulm Rod & Gun Club), a G&F rock pier and the dam, with no camping symbol. Imagery shows a mown lawn in a shelterbelt south of the lake with picnic structures, but no pads, pedestals or RVs. The only 'campground' trace is the ndtourism title, which is never a source; MapQuest and countyoffice list 'Kulm Edgeley Dam Campground' at a Kulm street address marked CLOSED.
name: Kulm-Edgeley Dam (Kulm Dam WMA)
inclusion_evidence: Read 2026-11-12. (1) ND G&F Fishing Waters layer (ndgishub GNF_FishingWaters/0) for Kulm-Edgeley Dam (lake 191, 30.7 ac): Management 'Lamoure County WRD', 'FDAA constructed'; PublicAccess 'WMA - 38.58 acres, including dam and portion of N. & S. shoreline near dam'; directions '4 miles west, 2 miles south of Edgeley'. (2) Facilities layer (/4): concrete ramp 46.32875,-98.81912, wheel dock and concrete vault toilet 46.32824,-98.81759, all owned by the Kulm Rod & Gun Club; G&F rock fishing pier (SE corner); a security light; the dam at 46.32990,-98.81598 (east end). G&F's facility codes have no camping class. (3) G&F contour map kulmedgeley2022.pdf: ramp, vault toilet and fishing pier only. (4) WMA layer (All_GovtLands_State/4): 'Kulm Dam' WMA, 38.4 ac, bbox -98.8203..-98.8143, 46.3277..46.3313. G&F WMA listing: 'Kulm Dam 6 miles east, 2 miles north, .5 miles west of Kulm. 38'. (5) G&F WMA regulations (gf.nd.gov/wma, August 2026): primitive camping allowed up to 10 consecutive days unless posted; no designated sites. (6) City of Edgeley lists 'Edgeley-Kulm Dam' only under Fishing (edgeley.com/fishing); its Parks page names only the Edgeley Campground (28 hookups). (7) LaMoure County site and Water Resource District minutes 2022-2026: no mention of camping at the dam. (8) ND HHS licensed RV parks/campgrounds 07.17.2025: no row (LaMoure County rows are Edgeley Campground, Kulm Park, KCDC Park and LaMoure County Memorial Park).
waterfront_evidence: Not audited to a value (skip). For the record, 2026-11-12, from Esri World Imagery at 300 m, 110 m and z18 (all rendered): the only possible camping ground is a mown lawn inside a shelterbelt at about 46.3277-46.3286, -98.8172..-98.8145, south of the lake's east basin. It is beside the lake, not below the dam, which is at the east end. Open-Meteo DEM: 535 m on the lawn against a full pool of 1,735.4 ft (528.9 m). Water is about 70-100 m north, past the tree row and the gravel access track.
flags: Phone-list candidate: whether the Kulm Rod & Gun Club (which owns the ramp, dock and toilet) keeps a designated camping area, possibly with electric, on the shelterbelt lawn south of the lake. ndtourism search snippets claim 'primitive camping by small lake' and electricity, and give 701-269-3743 and 701-215-2402. Both numbers come only from ndtourism snippets and are unverified. If the club confirms designated sites, re-open as an add pinned at 46.3281,-98.8160.
Duplicates: none within 5 km. The nearest entry is 13574 Weaver Park Campground (Edgeley), about 9 km ENE in town, a different place; 5993 Kulm City Campground is about 10 km west.

MapQuest and countyoffice carry 'Kulm Edgeley Dam Campground - CLOSED' at 10 1st St SW, Kulm (701-647-2451). They look like a stale directory record, but this is the only listing that says anything about status.
